sections.title: A New Yield Asset Class
sections.body: DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks) introduces a revolutionary revenue model for data centers. Instead of fixed monthly contracts, our revenue is a dynamic function of network tasks, uptime incentives, and protocol token appreciation. For the Kenya AI Compute project, DePIN serves as a 'High-Frequency Revenue Layer.' When a GPU is not rented by a private enterprise client, it automatically switches to performing tasks for networks like Render or io.net. This ensures that our 1MW capacity maintains nearly 100% 'utility' load, even if the 'commercial' utilization is lower. We carefully manage our token treasury, converting protocol rewards into stablecoins or USD to secure our OPEX, while retaining a portion for long-term appreciation. sections.title: DePIN Revenue Logic
items: Uptime Rewards: Consistent base earnings for providing certified hardware to the network.
Task Fees: Variable revenue from actual compute jobs (Rendering, Training).
Multiplier Bonuses: Higher rewards for low-latency and high-bandwidth connectivity.
Treasury Management: Strategic hedging of protocol tokens (RNDR, AKT, etc.) into USD.
Liquidity: Instant cash flow from protocol payouts with zero accounts receivable delay.
